tex_content.label: prop:symmetric-bilinear-orthogonal-basis
tex_content.html:
Proposition

Let $q$ be a symmetric bilinear form on a finite-dimensional vector space $V$ over a field in which $2$ is invertible. Then $V$ has a $q$-orthogonal basis $(b_i)$, meaning $q(b_i,b_j)=0$ for $i\ne j$.
